facts.fact: Joint venture marketing is an agreement between two companies that combine marketing strategies to increase their share of the marketplace and their revenues.
facts.quote: Joint venture marketing is an agreement between two companies in which both organizations combine marketing strategies in order to increase their share of the marketplace and increase their revenues.

facts.fact: Joint venture marketing is sometimes referred to as co-marketing or a strategic alliance.
facts.quote: Joint venture marketing, which is sometimes referred to as co-marketing or a strategic alliance, allows two companies to combine the strength of their marketing efforts

facts.fact: Unlike a partnership, joint venture marketing emphasizes only a combined marketing plan rather than combining all facets of the businesses.
facts.quote: with joint venture marketing, the emphasis is only on a combined marketing plan designed to help both companies reach their financial and marketing goals.

facts.fact: To start a joint venture, both companies enter a contract that spells out the venture's goals and the responsibilities of both parties.
facts.quote: To initiate a joint venture, both companies enter into a contract that spells out the goals of the joint ventures and the responsibilities of both parties.

facts.fact: A joint venture agreement might be terminated if the contract lets it expire within a specified amount of time or if both parties mutually decide to terminate it.
facts.quote: A venture agreement might be terminated if the contract has language that allows it to expire within a specified amount of time or a mutual decision is made to terminate the agreement.

facts.fact: In joint venture marketing, both companies share in the success or failure of the campaign, so the agreements do not carry large risk for either party.
facts.quote: Joint venture marketing agreements also do not carry large risk because both companies share in the success or failure of the marketing campaign

facts.fact: Joint ventures must avoid breaking anti-trust laws, and the federal government may intervene if the venture makes the two companies too powerful in their industry.
facts.quote: Joint ventures must be careful not to break anti-trust laws. If the federal government determines that the joint venture will make the two companies too powerful in their industry, they might intervene
